$comment: Copy this to data/sites.json and edit. sites.json is gitignored because it
contains Cloudflare zone and Netlify site identifiers.
TWO WAYS TO LIST A SITE:
1. "domains": a flat list of domains, one per Plausible site. Everything is
derived (slug, name, url, plausible.domain). Each entry is its own site,
subdomains included, because Plausible treats each as a separate property.
Paste your Plausible site list straight in.
2. "sites": full entries, for anything needing Cloudflare/Netlify/GitHub ids
or custom test pages. An entry here wins over the same domain in
"domains", so you can start with the shorthand and promote sites as you
add integration ids.
cloudflare.zoneId   Cloudflare dashboard > site > Overview > Zone ID
netlify.siteId      Netlify > Site configuration > Site ID (or the domain)
plausible.domain    defaults to the hostname of `url` when omitted
plausible.baseUrl   only when this site lives on a DIFFERENT Plausible
instance to PLAUSIBLE_BASE_URL
plausible.keyEnv    name of the env var holding that instance's API key
github.repo         owner/repo (case-sensitive)
testPages           paths to audit and capture by default
interactivePages    paths with scroll-driven image sequences

sites.name: Site on a second Plausible instance
